equity.level_reason: Race is the only social-position dimension with a quantified contrast (Black rate more than twice the White rate), introduced with 'however'. The report does not interpret the gap or name causes, so the level stays at 2; age and sex are not social-position framed.

level_alternative.reason: The 'however' contrast with equal case numbers reads as a framed disparity; a stricter reader would also require the interpretation that the text lacks.

equity.equity_measurement: Race-specific rates compare Black with White residents, not a fixed target; the population denominators for the race-specific rates are not described in the text.

notes: No test, regression or CI is reported; rate ratios such as 4.8 vs 2.3 per 100,000 are hand arithmetic and not procedures. Drowning is coded as injury; alcohol and drug use are risk factors among decedents. The primary contrast is the state rate against fixed referents; race is a secondary contrast with White as referent.
view_issues: Boating paragraph: '13 (48%)' of persons aged >13 years, but 13/34 is 38%; 48% matches a denominator of 27. Alcohol testing '72 (76%) of the 94' is 77% when rounded.
